summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點在投資與供應鏈調整：BOI前9個月投資額逾1.7兆泰銖、年增28%，EEC新增4個特別經濟促進區；本田計畫委託三菱於林查班工廠代工皮卡，反映代工夥伴擴增、產能配置需調整。另南奔府中小企業支持將大型零售商農產品付款期限限制在30天內，顯示現金流仍是關注重點。
summary_en: Thai investment momentum continues: BOI pledges topped THB1.7tn in 9 months (+28%) and the EEC added 4 special promotion zones. Honda will outsource pickup production to Mitsubishi at Laem Chabang, signalling OEM capacity shifts. SMEs backed a 30-day payment cap on large retailers to ease cash flow.

items.summary_en: The Thai EEC Board approved four additional special economic promotion zones to attract investment in target industries.
